result.question: I have Jameson Williams on my bench and George Pickens in my starting lineup, who should I pick?
result.answer: Start George Pickens over Jameson Williams. George Pickens has a significantly higher average target share (21.9% vs 15.2%) and air yards share (31.9% vs 34.1%), and he averages 10.9 half-PPR points per game compared to Williams's 9.7. While Jameson Williams has a more favorable week 7 matchup against a GB defense allowing 26 half-PPR points to WRs versus PHI's 31.8, Pickens's stronger team usage and consistent higher scoring output make him the better start in half-PPR.

claims.text: George Pickens: DAL, WR, roster status ACT (week 7). Jameson Williams: DET, WR, roster status ACT (week 7).

evidence.sql: SELECT r.gsis_id, r.full_name, r.team, r.position, r.status, r.week FROM NFLVERSE.rosters r JOIN (SELECT gsis_id, MAX(week) AS week FROM NFLVERSE.rosters WHERE season = 2026 AND LOWER(full_name) IN ('george pickens', 'i have', 'have jameson', 'jameson williams', 'williams on', 'on my', 'my bench', 'bench and', 'and george', 'pickens in', 'in my', 'my starting', 'starting lineup', 'lineup who', 'who should', 'should i', 'i pick', 'i have jameson', 'have jameson williams', 'jameson williams on', 'williams on my', 'on my bench', 'my bench and', 'bench and george', 'and george pickens', 'george pickens in', 'pickens in my', 'in my starting', 'my starting lineup', 'starting lineup who', 'lineup who should', 'who should i', 'should i pick') GROUP BY gsis_id) latest ON r.gsis_id = latest.gsis_id AND r.week = latest.week WHERE r.season = 2026 AND r.position IN ('QB', 'RB', 'WR', 'TE') ORDER BY r.full_name

claims.text: Pickens has a higher average target share (21.9% vs 15.2%) and air yards share (31.9% vs 34.1%), with 52 targets and 0 carries in 6 games compared to Williams's 29 targets in 5 games, and averages 10.9 half-PPR points per game versus 9.7.

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.player_display_name AS player, ps.team, COUNT(*) AS games, SUM(ps.targets) AS targets, ROUND(100 * AVG(ps.target_share), 1) AS avg_target_share_pct, ROUND(100 * AVG(ps.air_yards_share), 1) AS avg_air_yards_share_pct, SUM(ps.carries) AS carries, ROUND(AVG((ps.fantasy_points + ps.fantasy_points_ppr) / 2), 1) AS half_ppr_per_game FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id IN ('00-0037240', '00-0037247') GROUP BY ps.player_display_name, ps.team ORDER BY ps.player_display_name

claims.text: Jameson Williams's weekly half-PPR points jumped from 5.9 in weeks 1-3 to 15.5 from week 4 on (+9.6), while George Pickens's increase was smaller at +6.4 (from 7.7 to 14.1).

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.player_display_name AS player, 3 AS split_week, SUM(CASE WHEN ps.week <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS early_games, SUM(CASE WHEN ps.week > 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_games, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week <= 3 THEN (ps.fantasy_points + ps.fantasy_points_ppr) / 2 END), 1) AS early_half_ppr_per_game, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week > 3 THEN (ps.fantasy_points + ps.fantasy_points_ppr) / 2 END), 1) AS late_half_ppr_per_game, ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week <= 3 THEN ps.target_share END), 1) AS early_target_share_pct, ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week > 3 THEN ps.target_share END), 1) AS late_target_share_pct FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id IN ('00-0037240', '00-0037247') GROUP BY ps.player_display_name ORDER BY ps.player_display_name

claims.text: Jameson Williams scores 24.7% of his half-PPR points from touchdowns versus George Pickens's 9.2%, making Williams significantly more touchdown-dependent.

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.player_display_name AS player, SUM(ps.receiving_tds + ps.rushing_tds) AS touchdowns, 6 * SUM(ps.receiving_tds + ps.rushing_tds) AS td_points, ROUND(SUM((ps.fantasy_points + ps.fantasy_points_ppr) / 2), 1) AS half_ppr_points, ROUND(100 * 6 * SUM(ps.receiving_tds + ps.rushing_tds) / NULLIF(SUM((ps.fantasy_points + ps.fantasy_points_ppr) / 2), 0), 1) AS td_share_pct FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id IN ('00-0037240', '00-0037247') GROUP BY ps.player_display_name ORDER BY ps.player_display_name

claims.text: Jameson Williams faces a significantly easier matchup in week 7, with GB allowing 26 half-PPR points per game to WRs (rank 17) compared to PHI allowing 31.8 to George Pickens (rank 3).

evidence.sql: WITH players AS (SELECT '00-0037240' AS player_id, 'Jameson Williams' AS player, 'DET' AS team, 'WR' AS position UNION ALL SELECT '00-0037247' AS player_id, 'George Pickens' AS player, 'DAL' AS team, 'WR' AS position), games AS (SELECT home_team AS team, away_team AS opponent, week, home_score FROM NFLVERSE.schedules WHERE season = 2026 UNION ALL SELECT away_team AS team, home_team AS opponent, week, home_score FROM NFLVERSE.schedules WHERE season = 2026), target AS (SELECT team, MIN(week) AS week FROM games WHERE week > 6 GROUP BY team), allowed AS (SELECT opponent_team, position, week, SUM((fantasy_points + fantasy_points_ppr) / 2) AS pts FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats WHERE season = 2026 GROUP BY opponent_team, position, week), avg_allowed AS (SELECT opponent_team, position, ROUND(AVG(pts), 1) AS avg_half_ppr_allowed, COUNT(*) AS opp_games FROM allowed GROUP BY opponent_team, position), ranked AS (SELECT opponent_team, position, avg_half_ppr_allowed, opp_games, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY position ORDER BY avg_half_ppr_allowed DESC) AS allowed_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY position) AS teams_ranked FROM avg_allowed) SELECT p.player, p.team, p.position, t.week AS game_week, g.opponent, CASE WHEN g.home_score IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS played, r.avg_half_ppr_allowed AS opp_avg_half_ppr_allowed, r.allowed_rank, r.teams_ranked, r.opp_games FROM players p LEFT JOIN target t ON t.team = p.team LEFT JOIN games g ON g.team = p.team AND g.week = t.week LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.opponent_team = g.opponent AND r.position = p.position ORDER BY p.player
